feeds.title: Chocoviv's Lifestyle Blog
feeds.description: Mommy blogger, who loves to share what she loves!

feeds.title: The Wagamama Diaries
feeds.description: I'm Teni Wada. I'm a Tokyo-based entrepreneur and content creator that's worked with many of Japan's top cosmetics brands. My lifestyle blog, The Wagamama Diaries, has topics related to Japanese beauty products and motherhood in Japan.

feeds.title: Tiny Tot In Tokyo
feeds.description: Sharing tips about pregnancy in Japan, interviews with other international mothers, recipes for babies and toddlers, as well as product reviews. Tiny Tot in Tokyo is the journey of a Canadian mom raising her first child in Japan.

feeds.title: The Tokyo Chapter
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Jo and this is my blog. I blog about all things Japan right from motherhood, travel, lifestyle, and more. My blog about me just being me and sharing little snippets of my life, mistakes I've made, things I'm loving in Tokyo right now, and the tips and tricks that I wish I'd worked out much sooner in 12 years, in total, living in Japan

feeds.title: The Haruna Home
feeds.description: My name is Hannah. We are the Harunas, an international family living in rural Japan. This is our site where we share about slow life in the countryside, our multicultural family, what it's like to be an immigrant, and much more.

feeds.title: RecipeTin Japan
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Yumiko. I was born & raised in Japan and migrated to Australia with my family in 1981. I got tired of my kids constantly asking me for their favorite Japanese recipes, so I decided to collate them in one place so they can help themselves. This blog is a collection of Japanese home cooking recipes, plus special occasion Japanese recipes that I have cooked & liked.

feeds.title: Chopstick Chronicles
feeds.description: My name is Shihoko. I moved to Australia many years ago from Japan and I missed the food so much that I decided to create my favorite recipes at home and share them with you too.

feeds.title: Create Eat Happy
feeds.description: Easy, Tasty, Fun, Creative and Kawaii Japanese Food Recipes and Cooking Hacks Blog with How-To YouTube Cooking Show Video Tutorials.

feeds.title: YUCa's Japanese Cooking
feeds.description: YJC is a Japanese home cooking class in Tokyo. Yuca is the author behind the blog and a mom herself.

feeds.title: the Last Cherry Blossom
feeds.description: I am Kathleen. I'm the daughter of a Hiroshima survivor and a native Japanese and also the author behind the blog.

feeds.title: Actually Angie
feeds.description: Hello, I'm Angie, a mom, a wife, a student, and a writer living in Yokohama, Japan. Actually Angie is dedicated to sharing my experience as a foreigner in a culture vastly different from my own!

feeds.title: JustHungry
feeds.description: Hi everyone. My name is Makiko Itoh. Just Hungry is a food blog, established in 2003. My primary focus here on Just Hungry is Japanese food and home cooking. I try to always present recipes and methods for people who do not live in Japan and may not be familiar with Japanese cooking or have access to a wide selection of Japanese ingredients.

feeds.title: Mochi Mommy
feeds.description: Mochi Mommy is a blog about Asian-inspired recipes and family life. The blog was created by Christina, a mom of two who loves to cook and bake. She shares her recipes for both savory and sweet dishes, as well as tips and tricks for making Asian food at home. The blog also features posts about Christina's family life, including her experiences as a mom of two young children.

feeds.title: Traveling Tokyo with Kids
feeds.description: Traveling to Tokyo with kids? As a parent raising a child in central Tokyo, I'd like to share useful tips for parents and their kids based on my experience. I hope your family enjoys Japan!

feeds.title: Tokyo Doula Support
feeds.description: I'm Stephanie Kawai and I've been in Japan since 2000. Tokyo Doula Support is a comprehensive resource for English-speaking families in Japan, offering prenatal, birth, and postpartum doula services. Led by Stephanie Kawai, a UK-born doula residing in Tokyo since 2003, the blog provides valuable insights into navigating childbirth and early parenting in Japan.

feeds.title: My Motherhood Tokyo
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Jocelyn! I moved to Japan in 2016 and have met my husband and have had three kids since then! Through this blog, I hope to give you the information you need in order to feel confident about parenting in Japan. The content spans everything from hospital recommendations to breastfeeding to travel tips.

feeds.title: International Mothers Community in Yokohama
feeds.description: This is the blog of the group International Mothers Community in Yokohama. The group is mainly for international mothers living and raising kids in Yokohama.

feeds.title: Kitchen Princess Bamboo
feeds.description: Welcome to Kitchen Princess Bamboo, Japanese Everyday Food. My name is Akino Ogata! I will bring you the best Japanese Recipe from Japan!

feeds.title: We Speak Japanese and English
feeds.description: I am Amy. My family is what is important to me - my curious son and my excellent husband. My husband is Japanese. In this blog, I write mostly about teaching English to my son. And whatever else happens to pop into my mind.

feeds.title: Hiragana Mama Blog
feeds.description: Resources for teaching children the Japanese language and culture. A Japanese-American mom trying to teach her half-Japanese children to be bilingual and bicultural.

feeds.title: Ninja Mom
feeds.description: Ninja Mom is a personal blog chronicling the experiences of Janine, an American missionary and mother of three, as she navigates life in Japan. Through her posts, she offers insights into the challenges and joys of raising Third Culture Kids (TCKs), cross-cultural ministry, and the intricacies of daily life in Tokyo.

feeds.title: That Japan Life
feeds.description: I am Jill, a Filipina mom living in Yokohama, Japan. After almost five years of dating, I married my Japanese boyfriend and left everything behind to start a new life in Japan. This blog helps other clueless gaijins out there tackle the more challenging aspects of life in Japan such as learning the language, being a foreign parent, and, well, choosing the best sanitary napkin.

feeds.title: The Tokyo Mom
feeds.description: I'm, Rupal, an expat currently living in Tokyo, Japan with my husband and our toddler daughter. I love travel, new culinary adventures, organization, nature, yoga, Japanese crafts, being a mama, and of course all things Tokyo, Japan.
